scope: Read-only source and two bounded scratch JS lifecycle probes of the exact 2f initial memory reader. No app/test/source/ref or acceptance changes.
verdict: NO_READER_MOUNT_CAUSE_REPRODUCED: required read completion exposes the reader even with reduce-motion/native animation acknowledgement held; no dependency-driven repeat load or inactive audio startup was observed in the controlled host. The actual iPhone busy-main-thread symptom remains unattributed.

sourceFindings.finding: The initial loading return creates only SafeAreaView/View/ActivityIndicator. Cover, MemoryPageTurn, Film, export and settings are not mounted in that branch.

Required load dependencies are owner ID, album ID, viewer ID and auth-ready boolean. Owner profile and optional reaction state updates do not change them. Optional reactions are detached; required auth/book reads can remain pending, but their runtime state was not retained.

Pre-content native-facing work includes AppState/dimensions/reduce-motion subscription, Animated stop/setValue and one timing start toward scale1. No explicit Reanimated/shared-value or synchronous native result read was found in this path.
The callback that invalidates a full book read runs only after an explicit save/check and verified book response; it is not a mount callback.
Both reader soundtrack instances are inactive with null initial selections; their initial path performs no Sound.createAsync or track fetch.
The exact navigation book has two text pages, no media URL or stickers. The actual hydrator returns directly without private-media auth/signing stages for that fixture.

probe.execution: PASS: two scratch scenarios; not added to formal regression totals.
observations: Both resolved and indefinitely held reduce-motion callbacks settle to seven renders after required book response.
Exactly one auth read, one required book read and one optional reaction read; repeated flushes with held reads do not add renders/requests.
One explicit background→active event creates exactly one warm refresh while authorized content remains shown.
Unmount leaves zero auth/AppState subscriptions and no active interval in the host.
probe.nativeLimitation: Controlled native APIs do not emulate UIKit, XCTest snapshot/idle handling, the RN/Fabric scheduler or native module callback delivery. No proof that the real required response completed or that these source exclusions diagnose its stall.

nextDecision: Keep production reader unchanged for the frozen grouped repair gate. Correlate any future actual body/auth/UI/native stack evidence before attributing or changing the initial reader path. Do not relax flow assertions or deadlines.
